description: Raw measured air-pollutant sample values from EPA AQS for a date range — the regulatory record, by site, county, state or CBSA. AUTHORITATIVE for "what was the actual ozone/PM2.5/lead concentration here on these dates"; this is the quality-assured archive, not the provisional real-time AQI. Sourced from the EPA Air Quality System. Requires an EPA AQS email + key.

_apiKey.description: EPA AQS credential as "<email>:<key>", or just "<key>" with email= set. Register at https://aqs.epa.gov/data/api/signup?email=<your-email>

bdate.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD (converted to the AQS YYYYMMDD form for you)

cbsa.description: Five-digit CBSA code — required for by=cbsa

county.description: Three-digit county FIPS — required for by=county/site

edate.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD — must be in the SAME calendar year as bdate

email.description: The email the AQS key was issued to, if not folded into _apiKey

limit.description: Max sample rows to return (default 200, max 2000)

param.description: Pollutant parameter code(s), comma-separated, max 5. e.g. "44201" (ozone), "88101" (PM2.5), "42401" (SO2), "14129" (lead)

site.description: Four-digit site number — required for by=site

state.description: Two-digit state FIPS — required for by=state/county/site

name: aqs_sample_data
title: Aqs Sample Data
